a.lede: Nvidia’s cofounder and chief executive resigned on Thursday after the company opened an investigation into his affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
a.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has until the end of the day Wednesday to answer a call from House Republicans for a closed-door briefing on his affair with alleged Chinese spy.
b.title: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair
